title: Ask another system from the chat
summary: A tool for builders: type its word and a value, it asks a web address and shows two chosen fields of the answer.
description: A tool for your team that asks another system, used from the chat on the web, the phone app, WhatsApp, Telegram and Slack. Type its word and a value ("/check-order AD-12"): it reads the web address you give, with the value added as q, and shows the two fields of the answer you choose, as a card. It only reads (it never changes anything there), so it answers at once. For someone who knows the other system's address. Choose the word it is called by when you install it; if that word is taken, it gets the next free one (check-order-2) and says so.

params.name: command
params.title: Its word
params.description: What people type to use it, after /. Letters, numbers and dashes.

params.name: address
params.title: Web address
params.description: The address it reads, starting with https://, with no name or password in it (keep those in a secret).

params.name: first_field
params.title: Shows first
params.description: A field of the answer it shows, such as status.

params.name: second_field
params.title: Shows next
params.description: Another field of the answer it shows.

definition.name: Ask a system
definition.description: Calls a web address and shows chosen fields of what comes back.
